title: Barcelona to the Costa Brava
structure: W Barcelona (3 nights) → Costa Brava (2 nights) → Le Méridien Barcelona (1 night + departure)

days.label: Tue Aug 11
days.theme: Arrival, Gothic Quarter, El Born & Flamenco

events.title: Arrive BCN → Taxi to W Barcelona
events.details: Barcelona-El Prat Airport. Allow 60–90 minutes for immigration, baggage, and transfer to the hotel.

events.title: Arrive at W Barcelona
events.details: Drop luggage if room not ready. No timed attractions this morning.

events.title: Beachfront Walk → Snack
events.details: Walk along Sant Sebastià Beach and Barceloneta promenade. Light snack or drink. Relaxed first look at Barcelona.

events.title: Lunch in Barceloneta
events.details: First proper meal: croquetas, pan con tomate, grilled fish, tapas. Save the big paella for later.

events.title: W Barcelona Reset
events.details: Room check-in, shower, quick refresh before heading out.

events.title: Gothic Quarter
events.details: Barcelona's medieval heart. Walk Plaça Reial → Carrer del Call → Plaça Sant Jaume → Cathedral → Pont del Bisbe → Plaça del Rei → Temple of Augustus. 2,000 years of history, no tickets needed.

events.title: El Born → Toward Palau Dalmases
events.details: Walk east into El Born. Santa Maria del Mar, Passeig del Born, Carrer de Montcada. Browse boutiques and galleries. End up at Palau Dalmases.

events.title: Flamenco — Palau Dalmases
events.details: Intimate flamenco in a 17th-century baroque palace. Zone A seating. Montcada, 20 (next to Picasso Museum).

events.title: Dinner in El Born
events.details: Tapas-focused dinner in the neighbourhood's atmospheric streets. You're already here.

events.title: Port Vell → Return to W
events.details: Walk toward the harbour, then taxi back. One drink at the hotel or straight to sleep.

days.label: Wed Aug 12
days.theme: Gaudí, Gràcia & Casa Batlló Magical Night

events.title: Breakfast at W Barcelona
events.details: Relaxed breakfast at the hotel. No aggressive start needed after your first full Barcelona day.

events.title: Taxi → Sagrada Família
events.details: See the basilica and walk around the exterior. If exterior-only, roughly an hour is plenty. One of Barcelona's most extraordinary buildings.

events.title: Walk Avinguda de Gaudí
events.details: Tree-lined pedestrian boulevard northwest from Sagrada Família. Natural continuation rather than jumping into a taxi.

events.title: Lunch near Sagrada / Lower Gràcia
events.details: Eat here before continuing west. Don't return toward Passeig de Gràcia for lunch yet.

events.title: Explore Gràcia
events.details: Plaça de la Vila de Gràcia, Carrer de Verdi, surrounding side streets. A distinctly different, village-like part of Barcelona away from tourist monuments.

events.title: La Pedrera → Passeig de Gràcia
events.details: Walk south: see Casa Milà exterior and stroll Passeig de Gràcia. Full interior tour optional — you have Casa Batlló tonight.

events.title: Return to W → Pool & Rest
events.details: Taxi back. ~2 hours at the hotel: pool, beach, shower, nap, get ready. The evening becomes its own event.

events.title: Light snack → Get ready
events.details: Do NOT schedule a major dinner. Casa Batlló runs until ~22:00 — main dinner comes after.

events.title: Taxi → Arrive at Casa Batlló
events.details: Comfortable buffer. Exterior photos, get organized. 15-minute entry window from booked time.

events.title: Casa Batlló Magical Nights — GOLD
events.details: Centerpiece of the evening. 20:00: building visit begins. 21:00: rooftop concert. ~22:00: concludes. Passeig de Gràcia, 43.

events.title: Late Dinner in Eixample
events.details: Proper dinner after the show. One of Barcelona's best restaurant areas. 22:15 dinner fits perfectly.

events.title: Return to W Barcelona
events.details: Taxi back to the waterfront. End of a big day.

days.label: Thu Aug 13
days.theme: Park Güell, Montjuïc, W Beach Afternoon & Barceloneta Evening

events.title: Breakfast at W
events.details: Last morning at the W before Costa Brava tomorrow.

events.title: Taxi → Montjuïc
events.details: MNAC viewpoint, Olympic area, gardens, miradors, skyline views. Don't try to walk the entire hill.

events.title: Taxi → Gràcia Coffee
events.details: Head to Gràcia for coffee and a pastry before Park Güell.

events.title: Park Güell
events.details: Monumental Zone, Hypostyle Room, serpentine mosaic bench, city viewpoints. Entry at 12:30, valid for 30 min after. ~90 minutes.

events.title: Lunch near Park Güell / Gràcia
events.details: Eat near the park or walk down into upper Gràcia for more options.

events.title: Return to W → Beach / Pool Afternoon
events.details: Taxi back. Proper chunk of afternoon at the hotel: pool, beach, spa, drinks. Transition from city sightseeing toward coastal vacation.

events.title: Barceloneta Walk
events.details: Walk from W along beachfront: Sant Sebastià → Barceloneta Beach → Barceloneta neighbourhood.

events.title: Seafood Dinner in Barceloneta
events.details: One of the main Barcelona dinners: grilled Mediterranean fish, gambas, croquetas, seafood rice, paella, fideuà.

events.title: Walk back to W
events.details: Beachfront promenade back to the hotel. Last night at the W.

events.title: Breakfast → Pack
events.details: Final breakfast at the W. Check out.

events.title: Checkout → Pick Up Rental Car
events.details: Collect luggage, pick up car. Arrange pickup to avoid driving through central Barcelona.

events.title: Drive to Begur
events.details: ~1.5–2 hours via AP-7 motorway through the Catalan countryside to the Costa Brava coast.

events.title: Begur Arrival → Drop Bags
events.details: Hilltop medieval town with a ruined castle and views across the Empordà plain to the sea.

events.title: Aiguablava
events.details: Crystal-clear turquoise water, pine-fringed cliffs. Swimming, snorkeling, kayaking, paddleboarding. Do not rush this.

events.title: Coastal Lunch
events.details: Long Mediterranean lunch at a terrace overlooking the water. Fresh fish, local wines, grilled prawns.

events.title: Hotel Check-in → Siesta
events.details: Check in properly. Shower, rest, enjoy the quieter pace.

events.title: Begur Old Town → Castle
events.details: Explore medieval streets. Walk up to Begur Castle for 360° views across the Empordà, Pyrenees, and Mediterranean.

events.title: Dinner in Begur
events.details: Dinner in one of the village squares. Catalan cuisine, grilled meats, local Empordà wines.

days.label: Sat Aug 15
days.theme: Calella de Palafrugell, Camí de Ronda, Llafranc, Pals & Peratallada

events.title: Breakfast
events.details: Morning meal at the hotel before a full coastal day.

events.title: Calella de Palafrugell
events.details: Postcard-perfect fishing village — whitewashed houses, small pebbly beaches, Port Bo arcades.

events.title: Camí de Ronda → Llafranc
events.details: Coastal footpath from Calella to Llafranc: pine-shaded trails, turquoise coves, rocky headlands. One of the trip's top experiences.

events.title: Llafranc
events.details: Elegant crescent beach, marina, seafront cafés. Far de Sant Sebastià lighthouse optional.

events.title: Long Seafood Lunch
events.details: Proper coastal feast: anchovies, gambas, suquet de peix, arròs negre, fideuà. Eat with sea views.

events.title: Swim → Relax
events.details: Back in the water at Llafranc or a nearby cove. No rushing to the car.

events.title: Pals
events.details: Medieval hilltop village — 10th-century Romanesque tower, cobblestone streets, panoramic rice-field views.

events.title: Peratallada
events.details: One of Catalonia's best-preserved medieval villages. Honey-coloured stone, moat-carved streets. Stunning in golden-hour light.

events.title: Dinner in Peratallada → Drive back
events.details: Eat in the atmospheric main square, then drive back to Begur.

days.label: Sun Aug 16
days.theme: Costa Brava → Le Méridien, Relaxed Final Barcelona Day

events.title: Breakfast in Costa Brava
events.details: Final morning on the coast.

events.title: Drive to Barcelona → Return Car
events.details: Drive south on AP-7. Drop rental car in Barcelona.

events.title: Taxi → Le Méridien Check-in
events.details: Le Méridien sits on La Rambla. Walk into Gothic Quarter, Plaça Catalunya, Passeig de Gràcia in minutes.

events.title: Central Barcelona Walk
events.details: Le Méridien → Plaça Catalunya → La Rambla → Gothic Quarter → Plaça Reial. Intentionally easy.

events.title: Lunch
events.details: Central Barcelona. Plenty of options within 5 minutes of Le Méridien.

events.title: Le Méridien Break
events.details: Relax at the hotel. Organize bags for tomorrow's departure.

events.title: Flexible Final Barcelona Block
events.details: Choose what you loved most: A) Passeig de Gràcia shopping, B) El Born boutiques, C) Gothic Quarter revisit, D) Palau de la Música, E) Port Vell sunset.

events.title: Farewell Dinner
events.details: Best or most celebratory dinner of the entire trip. Dress up, splurge, toast to the week.

events.title: Final Walk → Le Méridien
events.details: Walk back through the illuminated Gothic Quarter and La Rambla.

events.title: Breakfast
events.details: No rush. Final morning in Barcelona.

events.title: Final Walk
events.details: Option A: Gothic Quarter → Plaça Reial → La Rambla. Option B: Plaça Catalunya → Passeig de Gràcia. Coffee, pastries, souvenirs, photos.

events.title: Back to Le Méridien → Pack
events.details: Final packing, collect luggage, checkout.

events.title: Taxi → Airport
events.details: To Barcelona-El Prat. Target arrival ~3 hours before international departure.

toBook.title: Rental Car
toBook.detail: Pickup Fri morning, return Sun morning

toBook.title: Farewell Dinner
toBook.detail: Sunday evening, best meal of the trip
